lo.t: Opens 12 AM day before performance, closes 3 PM day before. Winners drawn at 10 AM and 3 PM.
lo.inst: Winners notified by email and have five hours to claim and purchase tickets online. Limit 2 tickets.

sg.ra: Choose rows E-L in the Center Orchestra for some of the best views in the theater. These rows are far enough back to take in the whole set while retaining detail and avoiding front-row neck craning.
Choose rows A or B for an elevated, detailed view that is incredibly close to the stage. These are premium-priced seats, but they are among the best views in the Mezzanine.
Rows M-O offer quality views at better rates. In row P, the Mezzanine overhang can affect the top of the stage.
The rear seats do not feel too far removed from the action.

sn.c: The front rows (AA, A and B) sit below a high stage, so you spend the show looking up and can miss action further back on stage.
sn.sh: Below a high stage, so expect neck craning

sn.lo: Mezzanine, far sides, rows A to B
sn.c: In the Left and Right Mezzanine, the outer seats (25 to 28) of rows A and B are partly blocked by the boxes that jut out beside the stage.
sn.sh: Outer seats in rows A and B are blocked by the boxes

sn.c: Toward the far left and right of the Orchestra the view can be partly blocked. Those seats sell for a little less.
sn.sh: Partial view toward the far sides

sn.c: In the last orchestra row (P), the mezzanine overhang cuts slightly into the top of the stage.
sn.sh: Mezzanine overhang trims the top of the stage

sn.c: The back rows of the mezzanine are some of the cheapest seats in the house, and in a theater this small they still have a clear view of the stage.
sn.sh: Some of the cheapest seats, still a clear view

sn.lo: Center Orchestra, rows E to L
sn.c: Center Orchestra rows E to L are the sweet spot: past the front rows where you look up, and still close enough for detail.
Mezzanine legroom is tight, so taller people should pick an aisle seat.

vs.sum: The Music Box Theatre offers excellent sightlines from most seats, making it ideal for intimate dramas, though sound quality can vary. The theater's charming Georgian-inspired design adds to its ambiance, while comfort and facilities are average for a Broadway venue.

acc.note: 5 wheelchair spaces in Orchestra. No steps from sidewalk. Infrared devices available.
